segments.text: Welcome back to half time report on CNBC TV 18 if tea is now trading at the days highest point 22713 is where the nifty is at.

But global investing banking firm Jeffries has made changes to its model portfolio and as for the latest note the risk reward is becoming more favorable for large caps in India and this is on account of relative valuation versus the product markets.
Let's bring on what was out to give us the details help us understand the perspective as well.

What was over to you? That's the big takeaway from this Jeffries note is the fact that the risk reward is turning favorable towards the under performing large caps and that is of course because of the better relative valuations in comparison to the outperforming mid caps and a narrowing earnings growth gap over the next three years.
This is what Jeffries has highlighted and therefore it has made some tweaks to its model portfolio.
It has increased its weightage on land's industries 27.5% from the existing positions that it has and it has made two new additions to it.
Kotak Mahendra bank is one addition and well spun corp is the other let's take a look at them individually as well.

Now for reliance it says that the stock at 8.4 times its eve to a bit a one year forward is trading at very attractive valuations and there are of course it is at a 23% discount to its 10 year historical average and also the fact that there is a potential for an earnings upgrade considering the higher GRMs that it may report going forward.
So for Kotak they are saying that the CEO succession overhang is finally over and therefore that is one key reason why they have included the stock in the model portfolio.

This too at 1.8 times its price to book value is trading at a 50% discount to its 10 year average valuations and therefore they are attractive as well and of course they see potential for the growth for the bank to accelerate from the current 15% plus levels for well spun corp.

So well they call it a beneficiary of the multi-year up cycle in the oil and gas infrastructure spends that you are seeing both in the United States and in West Asia as well and it should also benefit from the fact that it has local manufacturing available in both of these geographies.

Now on the flip side they have trimmed their weightages on rate sensitive so they have cut their weightage on the NBC space the real estate space although they continue to remain overweight on that and of course the fact that they have cut their weightage on isher motors as well.

Now the big trigger of course for tomorrow is the monetary policy they are saying that although they are expecting a rate hike this time around but this time around the cycle will be a shallower one and instead of the 250 basis points rate hike that you saw back in 2022 they are expecting only a 50 to 75 basis points rate hike from the RBI this time around.

Now they have also said that during this Jan to June 2022 period when this rate hike has happened the MSCI India valuation premium had compressed by 22% compared that to a shallower rate hike cycle in 2018 the valuation that compressed only 7%.

Now the MSCI India therefore is down around 10% from its August peak and therefore is under performing the emerging market peers because of the higher interest rate worries as well and therefore they say that it is the large cap stocks that will provide that of course are trading below the historical valuations

will provide some place to hide for the investors and so the bigger take away that large caps the risk rate water starting attractive increasing weightage on reliance and quota can well spend caught two new additions to Jeffries's model portfolio.

Okay all right thanks very much for bringing us that update almost just want to point out that the double stock has now moved to the high point of the day along with the markets as well but that's on the back of its Q2 update where the consolidated revenue growth is expected to be in double digits and they are expecting their hair oil shampoo segment to grow in double digits as well so good going in terms of the update that they've reported the stock as you can see has seen a spike post that use at the high point of the day for the markets as well.
The Nifty above 22,700 holding comfortably at those levels we take a short break more on the market's ones we're back, stay tuned.
